text:
The blocks lock the tail of the schedule. Ben–Cara–Dev must occupy three consecutive slots, and Hana–Ivo two consecutive slots. Finn, Elif, Ann, Gus, Hana, and Ivo all have to sit before Cara, and Ben is immediately before Cara, so those six fill slots 1–6 and Ben–Cara–Dev fill 7–8–9.

Finn is before Hana with a gap of at least three, so Hana–Ivo can only be 5–6 and Finn is in 1. The remaining slots 2–4 must hold Elif, Ann, and Gus: Elif before Ivo, Ann before Gus, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, and Ann at least three slots from Ivo. That places Elif, Ann, Gus.

Every other block placement leaves no slot that satisfies the gaps and the order constraints together.
